  "definition": "A patch lies closer to A when more of its visible area consists of continuous dark blue water, with little near-infrared red response and few terrestrial features. It lies closer to B when vegetation, fields, roads, or other land textures occupy more of the scene. Featureless black areas alone are inconclusive.",

    "Extent of continuous dark blue water versus recognizable land cover.",
    "Fine, repeated wave-like texture across broad areas at A.",
    "Extensive red or pink vegetation in false color at B.",
    "Field boundaries, roads, clearings, and varied terrestrial textures at B."
  ],
  "visible": "high"
}
